translations.web: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
translations.bsb: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.
translations.kjv: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
translations.asv: The first Woe is past: behold, there come yet two Woes hereafter.
